#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Admission only: the original native Tcl and all numerical policies are unchanged.
set -euo pipefail
pipeline=/home/yaz80/wz_project/chisel_projects/kvpress/artifacts/rd1_wcg1_full_pipeline_20261108_r2q1
events=/home/yaz80/wz_project/chisel_projects/kvpress/logs/rd1_wcg1_dc_resource_20261108_r2q1.log
reported=false
while true; do
  busy=false
  if pgrep -f '/opt/synopsys/.*/common_shell_exec.*shell dc_shell' >/dev/null; then busy=true; fi
  enough=false
  if awk '/MemAvailable:/ {exit ($2 < 33554432)}' /proc/meminfo; then enough=true; fi
  if [[ $busy == false && $enough == true ]]; then break; fi
  if [[ $reported == false ]]; then
    echo WAITING_FOR_OTHER_DC_OR_32GIB > "$pipeline/resource_status"
    echo "KVZAP_RD1_WCG1_RESOURCE_WAIT busy=$busy memory_ok=$enough" | tee -a "$events"
    reported=true
  fi
  sleep 30
done
echo NATIVE_ADMISSION_GRANTED > "$pipeline/resource_status"
echo KVZAP_RD1_WCG1_RESOURCE_GRANTED_STARTING_ORIGINAL_NATIVE_COMMAND | tee -a "$events"
exec /opt/synopsys/dc2018/O-2018.06-SP1/bin/dc_shell "$@"
